blocks.text: Sunlight filled Billy’s office. Seth, Jenny, Flaming Head and Fist-O-Mite gathered around the desk while Billy sketched the laboratory’s loading doors.

Seth pointed to the tank Billy had drawn inside the chest. “I’ll climb up and keep its hands away from you.” Jenny traced a clear street beside the loading doors. “I’ll get people out of its path.” Fist dipped toward the pencil. “And make sure the doc looks the wrong way.” Billy circled the tank’s metal cradle. “Pull here. The glass has to stay whole.” Seth repeated the plan for Flaming Head, who would reach Perch and help him stay calm.
The pencil rolled out of Billy’s hand.
A low rumble passed through the floor. The window rattled in its frame. Then the building shook, and a stack of folders slid off the desk.
They rushed to the window.

The laboratory’s loading doors stood forced open behind the robot. It had walked out while the police still waited for command to authorize a visit. Now calls from shopkeepers filled the switchboard. The robot had come around Public Square and was advancing along Superior Avenue. One metal hand lifted a parked car and tipped it onto its roof. Its next step cracked the pavement. Daniel walked ahead of it with a megaphone, waving frightened people out of his way.
blocks.alt: Daniel addresses the city through a megaphone while his giant robot overturns parked cars, with Perch trapped in its chest tank.

blocks.text: “A boy with super powers is trying to stop me from helping this city!” His amplified voice bounced between the buildings. “He destroyed my equipment. He has a dangerous mutant glove with him. Don’t let them fool you!”
Another empty car rolled onto its side behind him.
“My machine will protect you,” Daniel shouted. “Stand clear and let me deal with them!”
Some people stared up at the robot. Others pulled children into shops or ran for the next street. A man beside a newsstand looked from Daniel to the morning paper, uncertain which story to believe.
Seth’s fingers dug into the windowsill. He loosened them, leaving five dents in the wood.
Through the robot’s open chest, Seth could make out the blue tank. Perch was still inside.
Jenny reached for her camera. “He wants people afraid of you before you can help them.”
“And me,” Fist said. “Mutant glove? He made me!”
Flaming Head moved between Seth and the window. “The time to act is now. But you need to protect your identities.”
Seth repeated the warning for Billy and Fist. He touched his face. Daniel already knew who he was.
“Orkleson knows you,” Flaming Head said. “The fisherman heard your name too. A mask can’t change that. It can keep more people from recognizing you at school or following you home.”
Jenny tucked her press badge into her bag.
The fiery face turned toward them. “Stay together. You won’t be hurt.”
Seth glanced at Jenny. She took a breath and nodded. He stepped beside her.
Flaming Head swept around them. A bright trail followed him, circling their shoulders, then their feet. Flames rose in a golden spiral until Seth and Jenny stood inside a column of light.
blocks.alt: Flaming Head circles Seth and Jenny in comforting golden flames while Billy and Fist recoil from the heat.

blocks.text: Seth expected a sting. Instead, the glow felt warm and comforting, like sunlight after a cold swim. Jenny watched the fire pass over her hands without flinching.
Billy stumbled back from the scorching heat and shielded his face. Fist retreated toward the open window.
“Easy! I’m leather!”
Flaming Head tightened his circle around Seth and Jenny. The heat faded from the rest of the room. Nothing had caught fire.
The golden light sank into their clothes. For a moment Seth could see only Jenny’s eyes across from him. Then the flames dwindled to sparks.

His hoodie and jeans were gone. An orange suit covered him, with white accents at his shoulders and sides, brown gloves and boots, and a white belt. A bold white Z marked his chest. He touched the orange mask covering his eyes, edged with white, then looked down at himself in disbelief.

Jenny wore a fitted pink suit with white stripes running along her legs. White boots and gloves completed it, and a white mask covered her eyes. She flexed her hands and took one careful step. The suit moved easily with her.

blocks.alt: Seth touches his orange eye mask and Jenny examines her white gloves as their new hero suits form and the last golden sparks fade.

blocks.text: “They’re clothes,” Flaming Head said. “You can take them off. You’ll need other things to wear afterward.” Seth relayed that to Billy, then tested the seam at his wrist. The fabric held.

Billy lowered his hands. Seth and Jenny stood beside him in their new hero gear, with Fist hovering at Seth’s shoulder and Flaming Head glowing above them. Outside, another heavy footfall shook the street.
blocks.alt: Seth wears an orange suit with white accents, a white chest Z and belt, brown gloves and boots, and an orange eye mask edged in white; Jenny wears pink with white leg stripes, boots, gloves and eye mask, beside Billy, Fist and Flaming Head.

blocks.text: Seth straightened. The suit had not made the robot smaller, or Perch any less trapped. But Jenny was beside him, and the others were ready.
Billy folded the sketch into his pocket. “Same plan. People clear, keep him looking away, then get our friend out.”
Jenny moved to the door. Fist dipped forward. Flaming Head’s flames rose, and Seth joined them.
Outside, Daniel raised his megaphone again. Jenny reached the stairs before his next word.
